commandPrefixHelp: Messages you write in Slack starting with this prefix become Kandev tasks. Default:
createUtilityAgentFirst: Create one in Settings → Utility agents
credentialsHelp: Open Slack in your browser, copy the value of the `{{cookie}}` cookie and the `{{prefix}}` token from local storage. Both are required.
integrationDescription: Capture Slack threads as tasks for the selected workspace. Type {{example}} in any thread you can see and the configured utility agent creates the task.
pasteCredentialsToTest: Paste a token and cookie to test the connection
pollingIntervalHelp: How often Slack is checked for new <1>{{prefix}}</1> messages. Lower = more responsive, higher = fewer Slack API calls. Range: {{min}}–{{max}}s. Default: {{fallback}}s.
promptTokensHelp: Custom prompts can reference <1>{{tokens}}</1>. When at least one is used, your template owns the full prompt; otherwise the default Slack-triage system prompt is prepended automatically.
secretsRequired: A session token and cookie are required.
triageAgentHelp: The utility agent that interprets each Slack message and creates the Kandev task. It runs with Kandev MCP tools wired in ({{tools}}) so it picks the destination Kandev workspace + workflow + repo from context. Built-in agents use your default model from <4>Settings → Utility agents</4>.
unsupportedAuthWarning: <0>Browser session auth (unsupported):</0> Slack rotates session cookies often, so you may need to reconnect when authentication expires. Bot installs and user OAuth are on the roadmap.
